bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea at Angelica & Crafthouse, a penthouse restaurant and cocktail bar with a wraparound terrace and panoramic views across Leeds.  The Afternoon Tea Menu offers a selection of savoury and sweet treats including an Egg Mayonnaise & Watercress sandwich, Korean Pork Belly with a Gochujang Glaze and Jasmine & White Chocolate Macaron with Passionfruit Gel.  Traditional Afternoon Tea costs £28 per person. Free Flowing, Bottomless Prosecco Afternoon Tea is also available for £53 per person.  Angelica & Crafthouse is located within Leeds City Centre in Trinity Shopping Centre and is within close proximity of Leeds Train Station.
